name: Geresdlak (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Geresdlak (a shield of red and blue with a bishop's crozier, a bunch of grapes and a stag).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
